messages:
jen_support: FYI acme-corp reporting intermittent 429s on dedicated pool rp-ded-01. Saw a sawtooth pattern — bursts every ~30s then clears. Can eng take?

sam_ops: I'm on it. Any request IDs / sample headers?

jen_support: Here's a snippet:
```http
POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED
x-tenant-id: acme-corp
Content-Length: 512
```
Response: 429, {"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","detail":"tenant_quota_units_exceeded"}
Request ID: r-0a1b2c3d

julia_ml: Do we have the tenant quota config? Could be units vs tokens mismatch.

sam_ops: Querying config store... got: tenant=acme-corp rate_limit=3600 units_per_minute; enforcement service reading units_per_second flag = 60

mike_oncall: oh no. Looks like a migration job last night changed the unit field semantics.

deploy-bot: [deploy config-migrations v2.14.8] applied at 2024-05-11T02:30:12Z :white_check_mark:

sam_ops: Reproducer: looped 40 requests 1s apart -> 429 after ~18 requests, then clears for ~12s, repeats. Logs show limiter token bucket refilled at rate 60 units/s but config intended 60 units/min.

korina_cs: This lines up with the customer's timeline — started right after we bumped their billing plan to "growth" on 2024-05-11.

julia_ml: Quick theory: migration interpreted per-minute quotas as per-second (or enforcement reads the wrong unit enum). That would make enforced rate 60x higher/lower depending on direction, producing the sawtooth.

sam_ops: Temp mitigation applied: tenant override bumped to cover immediate traffic while we patch. Command used:
```bash
rwctl tenant set-quota acme-corp --units 72000 --period minute
```

metrics-bot: alert cleared for rp-ded-01 (tenant=acme-corp) 429_rate -> baseline :white_check_mark: 

mike_oncall: Patching migration script now. Plan: 1) hotfix enforcement to honor stored period unit, 2) run audit across all tenants for unit mismatches, 3) backfill corrected values where needed.

jen_support: Customer updated and appreciates the quick workaround. CS will log billing impact for compensation discussion. Assigning postmortem to sam_ops + julia_ml.

sam_ops: I'll open a postmortem doc and run a global check query: `select tenant_id,period,value from quotas where period='minute' and value > 10000` to find outliers.

julia_ml: I'll help with root-cause and add regression tests to the migration. Also schedule a runbook update so we can flip tenant overrides safely.

jen_support: Thanks everyone :pray: Will mark as customer-facing resolved once audit complete.
